# Odoo 19 Repo Index

Machine-built inventory for model names, XML external IDs, seed records, views/security/actions, migrations/tests, namespace drift, and compliance.

**Generated by:** `python3 export_odoo_index.py`

---

## Index Files

| File | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `odoo_model_index.json` / `.txt` | Full model index: _name, _inherit, fields, compute methods, constraints |
| `odoo_xml_index.json` | Parsed XML records: id, model, noupdate, refs, evals |
| `odoo_external_id_registry.json` / `.txt` | Global collision detector: qualified IDs, model, noupdate, source |
| `odoo_dependency_graph.json` | Module dependency DAG |
| `odoo_dependency_order.txt` | Install order (topological sort) |
| `odoo_compliance_scan.json` | Odoo 19 compliance issues (namespace drift, deprecated patterns) |
| `odoo_transaction_spine.json` | Transaction spine modules: models, sequences, ref data |
| `odoo_migrations.json` | Migration scripts by module/version |
| `odoo_test_catalog.json` | Test file locations |

---

## Usage

```bash
# Find model
grep "plasticos.transaction" reports/repo-index/odoo_model_index.txt

# Check external ID collisions
grep "seq_plasticos" reports/repo-index/odoo_external_id_registry.txt

# Module load order
cat reports/repo-index/odoo_dependency_order.txt

# Compliance issues
cat reports/repo-index/odoo_compliance_scan.json
```

---

## What This Prevents

- Duplicate _name collisions
- Duplicated _inherit extensions
- Namespace drift (Plastos vs plasticos)
- External ID collisions (incoterms, payment terms, sequences)
- Seed modules loading before target models exist
- Odoo 19 deprecated patterns
